result.reason: The amendment minimally adds a Customer non-renewal right on 30 days’ notice and therefore fixes the notice-window issue. However, it does not include any cap on renewal price increases, as required by both the preferred position and the fallback. It also omits the 60-day Vendor reminder required by the preferred position. The existing 90-day convenience-termination provision remains, but it does not negate the separate 30-day non-renewal right. Drafting is generally clear, though the overlapping termination and non-renewal mechanisms could be clarified.
